title: Tiny, cute mobile phone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- phone body -->
  <rect x='30' y='12' width='40' height='76' rx='9' ry='9' fill='#3B5BA5'/>
  <!-- body highlight edge -->
  <rect x='33' y='15' width='34' height='70' rx='6' ry='6' fill='#5578CC'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='36' y='22' width='28' height='54' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#1B2440'/>
  <!-- cute face on screen: eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#7DF9FF'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#7DF9FF'/>
  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#E8FFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#E8FFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 52 Q50 58 55 52' stroke='#7DF9FF' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='49' rx='2.5' ry='1.6' fill='#FF8FB1'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='49' rx='2.5' ry='1.6' fill='#FF8FB1'/>
  <!-- home button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='3' fill='#8FB0E8'/>
  <!-- top speaker slot -->
  <rect x='45' y='16' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8FB0E8'/>
  <!-- side button -->
  <rect x='70' y='30' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#FFC94D'/>
  <!-- little heart sticker -->
  <path d='M74 68 c1.5,-2 4,-2 4,0.5 c0,2 -4,4.5 -4,4.5 c0,0 -4,-2.5 -4,-4.5 c0,-2.5 2.5,-2.5 4,-0.5 z' fill='#FF6FA5'/>
</svg>
